import sys

# Read the initial string t from the input
t = sys.stdin.readline().strip()

# Function to perform a query and get the result
def query(s):
    print("? " + s)
    sys.stdout.flush()
    return sys.stdin.readline().strip()

# Perform the first query to get the result after one operation
result1 = query(t)

# Perform the second query to get the result after two operations
result2 = query(result1)

# Perform the third query to get the result after three operations
result3 = query(result2)

# The final result after three queries will be the original string s
s = result3

# Print the answer
print("! " + s)
sys.stdout.flush()
